detail.longDescription: I notice that in the retrogaming community too: A flood of "Someone ported X to platform Y", "Someone decompile game Z", when "someone" basically is "some AI". Until last year I was excited about these things and ask "how did they do it" and "how did they bypass the limitation of platform Y". Now I think "Meh, it's probably slop, no insights in here", and I don't care at all. 🧵 3/5 # noai # coding # programming # retrocomputing # homecomputer
